intro: A practice copy of the formulae given in Higher papers. Learn the ones that are NOT given (box at the bottom). Always use the sheet printed in the exam paper itself.

panels.title: Arithmetic series
points: Sum to n terms: Sₙ = n/2 [2a + (n − 1)d]

panels.title: The quadratic equation
points: The solutions of ax² + bx + c = 0, where a ≠ 0, are x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) / 2a

panels.title: Trigonometry
points: In any triangle ABC: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C
Area of triangle = ½ab sin C

panels.title: Volume and surface area
points: Volume of cone = ⅓πr²h; curved surface area of cone = πrl
Volume of sphere = 4/3 πr³; surface area of sphere = 4πr²
Volume of prism = area of cross section × length
Volume of cylinder = πr²h; curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

blocks.h: Learn these: they are not given

bullets: SOH CAH TOA: sin x = opp/hyp, cos x = adj/hyp, tan x = opp/adj
Area of a circle = πr²; circumference = 2πr = πd
Speed = distance ÷ time; density = mass ÷ volume; pressure = force ÷ area
Gradient = change in y ÷ change in x; perpendicular gradients multiply to −1
